purpose: Permit deterministic per-shard first economic Gate-A execution without order-adaptive selection while preserving the frozen 60-shard universe and multiplicity discipline.

first_gate_execution.signal_observability: signal must be causally observable before entry

hypothesis_unit.unit: one distinct exact GA1 event-mask class per shard
hypothesis_unit.representative: lexicographically smallest SIGNAL_CONFIG_ID in the exact-mask alias class
hypothesis_unit.zero_event_class: retained with p_value=1 and cannot survive first gate

cross_shard_error_budget.reason: Every frozen shard receives the same ex-ante budget, so FIFO sequential opening cannot make later thresholds depend on earlier economic outcomes.

candidate_test.daily_axis: all eligible frozen DEV trading dates in chronological order; days with no trade contribute daily_R=0
candidate_test.daily_value: sum of realized anchored trade R for that canonical mask on that DEV trading date
candidate_test.hac_lag_rule: L=min(D-1,floor(4*(D/100)^(2/9))) where D is the number of DEV daily observations
candidate_test.degenerate_variance_rule: if SE is non-finite or <=0 then p_value=1
candidate_test.numeric_comparison: no metric rounding before hypothesis comparisons

within_shard_multiplicity.m: number of distinct exact GA1 event-mask classes in the shard, including zero-event class
within_shard_multiplicity.ordering: ascending raw p_value, ties by canonical SIGNAL_CONFIG_ID lexicographically
within_shard_multiplicity.critical_rule: find largest k such that p_(k) <= (k*q)/(m*c_m); reject hypotheses 1..k; if no k exists reject none

forbidden: changing GA1 masks after seeing economic results

shard_decision.PASS_FIRST_GATE: one or more canonical mask classes satisfy candidate_survival_rule
shard_decision.REJECTED_FIRST_GATE: zero canonical mask classes satisfy candidate_survival_rule after complete scoring and BY correction
shard_decision.INVALID_FIRST_GATE: data, execution, parity, or receipt integrity failure prevents a valid decision

downstream_controls.deflated_sharpe: diagnostic/downstream validation; cannot rescue first-gate failure
downstream_controls.White_SPA: downstream robustness/multiplicity diagnostic when computationally applicable; cannot rescue first-gate failure
downstream_controls.permutation_bootstrap: downstream adversarial validation; cannot rescue first-gate failure
downstream_controls.GA3_management: CLOSED until first-gate eligibility; cannot rescue a failed signal
downstream_controls.holdout: CLOSED until later frozen gate explicitly authorizes it
